verdict: Pages load quickly on desktop but the mobile experience needs work.

findings.title: Horizontal scroll at 320px
findings.issue: The services table is wider than the screen on small phones.
findings.impact_text: Mobile visitors must scroll sideways to read prices.
findings.fix: Let the table scroll inside its own container or stack its rows.

findings.title: Focus outline is removed
findings.issue: The CSS sets `outline: none` on links and buttons.
findings.impact_text: Keyboard users lose track of where they are.
findings.fix: Restore a visible focus style on all interactive elements.
